blocks.text: West Chilliwack Commercial & Industrial — Frequently Asked Questions

parts.t: Where is the West Chilliwack commercial and industrial area located?

West Chilliwack's industrial and commercial hub sits north and south of Highway 1 between the Lickman Road and Evans Road interchanges, extending along Yale Road West, Progress Way, and Keith Wilson Road.
What types of commercial and industrial properties are available in West Chilliwack?

Listings in West Chilliwack include light and medium industrial strata bays, freestanding manufacturing and fabrication shops, highway-fronting service commercial buildings, truck/equipment yards, and industrial development land.
Why do logistics and manufacturing businesses choose West Chilliwack?

West Chilliwack offers immediate four-way Highway 1 ramp access at Lickman Road and Evans Road, lower industrial land and lease costs compared with Metro Vancouver, and a local skilled trades workforce across
What zoning and environmental checks are required before buying in West Chilliwack?

Buyers should verify City of Chilliwack industrial or service-commercial zoning bylaws, floodplain and dike setback requirements, municipal water/sanitary servicing, and complete a Phase I Environmental Site Assessment (ESA) required by commercial lenders.
How do ALR boundaries affect land in West Chilliwack?

Industrial parks along Lickman Road and Yale Road West border protected Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR) farmland. Always confirm whether a parcel is zoned urban industrial or sits inside the ALR before planning non-farm storage or expansion.
What building specifications should industrial buyers check?

Verify clear ceiling height, grade-level vs dock-level loading doors, 3-phase electrical amperage, crane capacity or reinforced floor slabs, yard marshalling depth, and strata bylaws if buying into an industrial strata complex.
